description: Creates or updates markets, matched by ItemId, then by name. A country can be in one market only.

items.description: A market: the countries it sells to, in one currency.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: The market's name, such as Europe.

Countries.description: The two-letter country codes the market covers. A country is in one market only.

Currency.description: The three-letter currency code prices are shown and charged in.

ExchangeRate.description: How much of the market's currency one unit of the store's currency is worth.

Rounding.description: How converted prices are rounded: None, WholeUnits, EndIn99 or EndIn95.

Culture.description: The language shoppers in the market see, or none to keep theirs.

PricesIncludeTax.description: Whether the market's prices include tax.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the market is in use.

Markets.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.
